searchText: It seems like prysm couldn't get the data from the el in a timely manner, so starts voting randomly now right, it's the ``` time="2024-12-10 09:43:13" level=info msg="Finished building block" prefix="rpc/validator" sinceSlotStartTime=1.018653293s slot=250116 validator=24770 ``` followed immediately by ``` time="2024-12-10 09:43:13" level=error msg="Could not get last block by latest valid time" error="Post "http://snooper-engine:8561": context canceled" prefix="rpc/validator" ``` which I'm not sure how to interpret it apparently could get the block The 2nd log has to do with eth1data voting, it is usually cached but if its not we try to retrieve it from the EL. Seems like the EL couldn't respond for it in time ok
